column1: # Flags a command's parser accepts that its `--help` deliberately does not list.
# scripts/check-cli-help-surface.sh compares the `"--flag"` literals in each
# src/<name>_cli_core.tl against the matching cli-<name>-help-text block in
# src/main.tl, and fails on any parsed flag that is neither documented nor
# listed here. Adding a user-facing flag therefore requires documenting it;
# adding an internal one requires saying so here, with a reason.
